Containers.Name: Connected Clients
Containers.Description: See who is connected to your Unraid server: web UI, SSH, SMB, NFS and VPN sessions, with a timeline and sign-in events.
Containers.Overview:
Connected Clients adds a page at Tools, Connected Clients. It shows who is connected to your server now, and who was connected in the last three days.
[b]Features:[/b] - Web UI sessions with the client address, the connection path (LAN, Tailscale, WireGuard) and the last request. - SSH, SMB and NFS v4 sessions, and active WireGuard and Tailscale peers. - A 24-hour or 72-hour timeline, and the sign-in events, including failed sign-ins. - A small collector reads these sources every 5 seconds. It only reads; it changes nothing on the server.
